_comment: Records where each installed component lives, how to start/stop it, and its ports/output dirs. Copy to config.json and adjust paths per machine — the paths below are this session's container paths and are NOT guaranteed to exist on a fresh container (see README.md's ephemeral-environment note).

crawlee.stop: one-shot CLI process; exits on its own

firecrawl.blockedReason: Docker Hub and GHCR blob CDNs both return policy-denied 403s in this session; see STACK_STATUS.md
firecrawl.notes: apps/api, apps/playwright-service-ts, apps/nuq-postgres build locally by default (not pre-built images); redis and rabbitmq are pulled pre-built. All require Docker Hub/GHCR access this session does not have.

browserUse.stop: script closes its own browser session (session.kill()) and exits; no resident process
browserUse.notes: Agent/autonomous mode needs an LLM (OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/Groq/Bedrock/Azure/Mistral/DeepSeek/Cerebras/OpenRouter/OCI/LiteLLM/Vercel/BrowserUse-hosted, or local Ollama). None configured; do not add a key or download a model without approval.

openLeads.notes: No installation located anywhere on this machine. Needs user input: source location (git repo / package / internal installer) before it can be installed or verified.

swiftSend.notes: Delivery step; not connected or configured by this stack, per instructions.
